_doc: Known, reasoned exceptions for scripts/contract (npm run test:contract). Every entry needs a reason; remove it once the backend spec is fixed.

specFixes.reason: Spec bug: GET /v1/app/config is documented as EnvelopeStatus (data.status required), but the Go handler (httpserver.handleAppConfig) answers {mode, name, registration_enabled, auth_methods, letterhead, ...} without `status`. The response schema is skipped until the spec documents the real payload.

Spec gap in otopoly-go wt/sms: POST /v1/tenant/contracts/instances/{uuid}/signers/{signerUuid}/otp accepts channel sms and the use case answers {channel: "sms"}, but ContractOtpChallenge.channel still lists only "whatsapp". Drop this fix once the enum includes sms.
